name: googletest
description: GoogleTest - Google Testing and Mocking Framework
one_liner: The standard, battle-tested framework C++ developers use to write automated tests for their code.
buyer: No one buys this and no one builds a business on it directly. It's foundational infrastructure that C++ teams simply use, for free.
business_use_cases: A C++ team writes reliable tests so their software ships with fewer bugs. That's the whole story.
A training provider could sell a 'testing C++ well' course that happens to teach it.
A tooling vendor could build a nicer test-runner UI on top of it, but the market is small and crowded.

money_ideas.idea: The only realistic angle is education or tooling around it (courses, IDE plugins), and both are low-margin, mature markets.

steal_this: Skip it as a business. If you write C++, just adopt it. It trends because it's a dependable staple, not because there's a new opportunity here.
